comment: Blood Sun step 6e (design §14, "Two-deviation gap"): the THREE-level chain. Fifteen lands (13 Swamps, 2 Mountains), opponent at 6: Dimir Machinations transmutes into Grim Tutor, Grim Tutor (in the transmute's continuation) fetches Diabolic Revelation (occurrence 0, rank 2), Revelation X = 2 takes both Lightning Bolts (occurrence 1, rank 3), and the Bolts kill this turn. Two simultaneous non-canon continuation choices: reachable only through MTG_BP_DEV_SEQ_ALL's compound slots (the shipped scope opens them at latent occurrences only, and wins T5). Before step 6e even _ALL won T5: FullSearchLine's pass 2 ran only when pass 1 met a LATENT occurrence, and under _ALL the occurrence a compound slot is built from was never recorded. MTG_BLOODSUN_USER_PRUNE=0 (Bolt is not a USER target). d3, budget 0.
